changes.title: This English professor has run with the bulls in Spain for two decades
changes.summary: When Bill Hillmann was 19 years old, he read Ernest Hemingway's The Sun Also Rises . That book inspired him to pursue two dreams: a career in literature and to run with the bulls in Pamplona, Spain.
